mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report (report_user_id, target_type, target_id, reason, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) VALUES (#{reportUserId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.report_user_id, u.name AS report_user_name, r.target_type, r.target_id, case r.target_type when 1 then g.title when 2 then tu.name when 3 then left(cm.content, 100) else null end AS target_name, r.reason, r.status, r.handle_admin_id, a.name AS handle_admin_name, r.handle_result, r.handle_time, r.create_time FROM report r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.report_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN admin a ON r.handle_admin_id = a.id LEFT JOIN goods g ON r.target_type = 1 AND r.target_id = g.id LEFT JOIN user tu ON r.target_type = 2 AND r.target_id = tu.id LEFT JOIN chatmessage cm ON r.target_type = 3 AND r.target_id = cm.id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE report SET status = #{status}, handle_admin_id = #{handleAdminId}, handle_result = #{handleResult}, handle_time = #{handleTime}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id}
